thin: Utility bill help is well listed and consistent (every list sends Mesa residents to MesaCAN and the City's own programmes). Phone and internet are thin: only 211 names any (Lifeline, TruConnect, one Phoenix internet lender); no official Mesa page lists low-cost internet offers such as Cox ConnectAssist, which Scout has only as Cox Lifeline.
